name: signal-bandwidth-to-impedance-target
description: Derive target impedance from signal rise time and protocol specification. Calculate knee frequency (0.35/t_rise for 10-90, 0.22/t_rise for 20-80), determine wavelength at knee frequency, set trace length threshold at lambda/10 for lumped vs distributed treatment, and extract impedance target from protocol spec (e.g., 50 ohm single-ended, 85/90/100 ohm differential for USB/HDMI/Ethernet).
